answer: Sybil resistance binds every identity to bonded collateral and correlates equivocation through timing, message, and stake provenance. When k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, the penalty scales as O(k^2); detection then applies an exponential multiplier to the controller’s capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation of residual escrow. A reef of aliases cannot outlast the horizon: one gale of evidence makes coordination uneconomic.
